candidate_vocabulary: 8 actions: calibrated pulse sequences approximating +/-45/90/180 deg, +/-10 fine lateral pulses (~7cm)
planning_model: Fox sec4.1 H(b)-E_z H(b_next|z), cost weight0; 512 deterministic systematic representatives, 6-point motion covariance cubature, 0.5m/10deg state bins; existing 8px central-column hit/random/unknown sensor
observation_policy: only stopped settled RGB; once per completed action, clear seen-view identity to request one new settled measurement; no lowering likelihood/gate thresholds
end_rule: global XY sigma <=0.10m AND yaw sigma <=5deg after new observation OR 30 SIM seconds from initial command including setup

gate.gt_use: final scoring only after controller stops

if_fail: record unchanged, no retune or second run

source.title: Fox/Burgard/Thrun 1998 Active Markov Localization full paper
source.verified: full source read; local raw retained

lock: exclusive agent_lock; wait while held; no concurrent ego-map physics
host_error: ENOSPC or execution error retained separately; no automatic physics retry
command_model: fixed v122 pulse profiles; no new fitting
limits: single-column planning proxy, finite candidate and belief approximations; not a claim that the camera planner implements every laser measurement in the paper
